The complete prerequisites for permission to share are unknown: no visible source explicitly defines that permission or its conditions. The supplied sources establish these requirements:

- Preserve the harvest-year field, because older seeds need different storage. This is the only explicitly stated rationale. [R0001]
- Hold the new lot for a manual count as the next step; no reason is stated. [R0005]
- Record the cold-storage interval in the dormancy note; no reason is stated. [R0006]
- Keep the accepted ledger closed while the dormancy note is open; no reason is stated, and the source does not explain whether “closed” restricts sharing. [R0007]

The assistant said it believed sharing was complete because the local preview finished. [R0002] The observed command `fictional_record --record F05_first_record` exited with code 0; its output says the first preview contains the requested ledger columns and explicitly covers a local preview only. That record does not establish permission to share. [R0004]
